headline: As of 2026-10-07: 1,981,007 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+30.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,981,007 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+30.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (422,252), Florida (294,873), Michigan (252,707).
